fit.summary: Designs centrifugal pump parts in SolidWorks with FEA and casting work now; EI, not yet a PE; no CFD.

bullets.text: Raised pump efficiency from 72.5% to 76% at 450 gpm by redesigning a cast impeller in SolidWorks

cover_letter.hook: Ironwood Fluid Systems designs the kind of centrifugal pumps I work on every day, and I would like to design them for municipal water.
cover_letter.body:
At Delta Pump Works I redesigned a cast impeller in SolidWorks that raised efficiency from 72.5% to 76% at 450 gpm, and I ran FEA on 12 pump brackets to cut their mass 18% with no loss in safety factor. Moving 3 castings to a local foundry saved $42,000 a year.

My senior design team built a solar-powered irrigation pump that delivers 1,800 gallons a day (example.com/priyaraman/solar-pump).
cover_letter.close: I would like to hear how your design engineers work with the test loop team on new impellers.

gaps: A PE license is preferred; Priya holds the EI and is not yet eligible.
No CFD experience; ANSYS Fluent is a plus.
